d: The Project Manager is responsible for planning, executing, monitoring, and delivering projects within the approved scope, timeline, and budget. d: Company Description Trust Global Consultants is a service provider specializing in passport and visa solutions for individuals and organizations. The company focuses on simplifying complex application and documentation processes to help clients travel and work abroad with confidence. Services typically include guidance on eligibility, documentation preparation, and submission support for various visa categories. Trust Global Consultants aims to deliver efficient, reliable, and compliant services that prioritize customer convenience and peace of mind. Team members work in a client-centered environment where accuracy, trust, and clear communication are essential.

Role Description The Sales Consultant role at Trust Global Consultants is a full-time, on-site position based in Muscat. The Sales Consultant will engage with prospective and existing clients to understand their passport and visa needs, present appropriate service options, and guide them through the selection and enrollment process. Daily responsibilities include conducting consultations, explaining service packages and pricing, handling inquiries in person and by phone, and following up with leads to convert them into clients. The role also involves maintaining accurate records of client interactions, collaborating with operations staff to ensure smooth service delivery, and actively seeking opportunities to enhance customer satisfaction. The Sales Consultant is expected to meet sales targets, contribute to promotional activities, and represent the company professionally at all times.
q: Candidates should possess strong Sales Consulting and Consulting skills, with the ability to understand client needs and recommend suitable solutions.
Candidates should possess Customer Service and Customer Satisfaction skills, focusing on delivering a positive and supportive client experience.
Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills, including clear verbal and written communication and active listening.
Candidates should preferably have experience in travel, immigration, or related service industries, with knowledge of passport and visa processes considered an advantage.
Candidates should demonstrate proven ability to meet sales targets, strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and proficiency with basic office and CRM software.
Candidates should hold a relevant diploma or bachelor’s degree and be able to work on-site in Muscat, including occasional extended hours based on client needs.
